entries.name: Security Awareness Training
entries.description: Employees complete security awareness training.

entries.name: Code Of Conduct Acknowledgment
entries.description: Employees acknowledge the code of conduct.
entries.declaration_text: I confirm that all personnel have acknowledged the organization's code of conduct during this period, either on hire or as part of the annual re-acknowledgment.

entries.name: Board Security Oversight
entries.description: The board exercises security oversight.

entries.name: Org Chart Security Roles
entries.description: An org chart documents security responsibilities.

entries.name: Background Check Policy
entries.description: A background-check process is documented.

entries.name: Accountability For Controls
entries.description: Individuals are held accountable for their internal-control responsibilities.
entries.declaration_text: I confirm that internal-control and information-security responsibilities are defined for each role, that individuals were evaluated against those responsibilities during this period, and that failures to meet them are addressed through the organization's performance and disciplinary processes.

entries.name: Information Security Policy
entries.description: A written information security policy exists.

entries.name: Internal Security Communication
entries.description: Security responsibilities are communicated internally.

entries.name: External Security Communication
entries.description: Security commitments, changes and incidents are communicated to external parties.

entries.name: Risk Assessment
entries.description: An annual risk assessment is performed.

entries.name: Fraud Risk Assessment
entries.description: Fraud risk is assessed.

entries.name: Fraud Risk Considered
entries.description: The potential for fraud is explicitly considered when assessing risks.
entries.declaration_text: I confirm that the potential for fraud was explicitly considered when assessing risks during this period, including management override of controls, incentives and pressures to commit fraud, and opportunities arising from privileged system access.

entries.name: Change Risk Assessment
entries.description: Significant changes that could impact the system of internal control are identified and assessed.

entries.name: Control Monitoring
entries.description: Controls are monitored on an ongoing basis.

entries.name: Control Deficiency Communication
entries.description: Internal-control deficiencies are evaluated and communicated to those responsible for corrective action.

entries.name: Control Selection Rationale
entries.description: Control design rationale is documented.

entries.name: Technology Control Activities
entries.description: General control activities over technology are selected and developed to support the achievement of objectives.

entries.name: Technology Controls Deployment
entries.description: Technology controls are deployed per policy.

entries.name: Access Review Quarterly
entries.description: A quarterly user access review is performed and signed.

entries.name: Subservice Org Reports
entries.description: Physical access to facilities hosting the system is restricted; for cloud-hosted infrastructure this control is carried by the subservice organization.

entries.name: Termination Process Documented
entries.description: An offboarding access-removal process is documented.

entries.name: Privileged Access Policy
entries.description: A privileged access management policy exists.

entries.name: User Provisioning Process
entries.description: A user provisioning/onboarding SOP exists.

entries.name: Asset and Media Disposal Process
entries.description: Data is made unrecoverable before equipment and media are disposed of or reused.

entries.name: Network Segmentation Policy
entries.description: A network segmentation policy exists.

entries.name: Firewall Review Policy
entries.description: A firewall-rule review process is documented.

entries.name: Data Classification Policy
entries.description: A data classification policy exists.

entries.name: Log Review Process
entries.description: A log review and alerting process is documented.

entries.name: Incident Response Plan
entries.description: An incident response plan exists.

entries.name: Incident Response Tested
entries.description: The incident response plan is tested.

items.text: Incident response plan was tested via tabletop exercise or simulation
All incident response roles and responsibilities were verified
Communication channels and escalation paths were tested
Lessons learned were documented and the plan updated accordingly

entries.name: Security Monitoring Policy
entries.description: A security monitoring and alerting policy exists.

entries.name: Vulnerability Disclosure Policy
entries.description: A vulnerability disclosure policy exists.

entries.name: Change Management Policy
entries.description: A change management policy exists.

entries.name: Security SDLC Process
entries.description: A secure SDLC process is documented.

entries.name: Penetration Test Annual
entries.description: An annual penetration test is performed.

entries.name: Vulnerability Management Policy
entries.description: A vulnerability management policy exists.

entries.name: Code Review Policy
entries.description: Code review requirements are documented.

entries.name: Vendor Risk Assessment
entries.description: Third-party / vendor risk is assessed.

entries.name: Due Diligence Process
entries.description: A vendor due-diligence process is documented.

entries.name: Vendor Contracts Reviewed
entries.description: Each vendor in the third-party register has a reviewed contract with security clauses on file.

entries.name: Vendor Onboarding and Termination Process
entries.description: A documented process governs vendor onboarding and termination, including revoking access and returning or destroying data.

entries.name: Vendor Assurance Evidence
entries.description: Each vendor in the third-party register has current assurance evidence on file.

entries.name: Complementary User Entity Controls Mapping
entries.description: Complementary user entity controls (CUECs) from each subservice organization's report are mapped to controls this organization operates.

entries.name: Capacity Management Process
entries.description: Current processing capacity and use of system components are monitored and evaluated to meet availability commitments.

entries.name: Business Continuity Plan
entries.description: A business continuity plan exists.

entries.name: Recovery Procedures Tested
entries.description: Disaster-recovery procedures are tested.

items.text: Recovery procedures were executed against a representative scenario
Recovery time and recovery point objectives (RTO/RPO) were met
Gaps identified during the test were documented and remediated

entries.name: Data Retention Policy
entries.description: A data retention policy exists.

entries.name: NDA Policy
entries.description: An NDA policy and template exist.

entries.name: Privacy Notice
entries.description: A privacy notice is published.

entries.name: Data Collection Policy
entries.description: A data collection and use policy exists.

entries.name: Personal Information Retention and Disposal Policy
entries.description: Personal information is retained only as long as needed and then disposed of.

entries.name: Processing Integrity Policy
entries.description: Processing integrity is documented.
